title: Bell: ring the terminal when a role needs the owner or a run ends

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S07 originally promised a bell with the live role detail. Owner 2026-10-24: moved to v1.1. Open for the owner when it is picked up: what rings it (a role needing you, a run ending, both), whether it is off by default, and the setting name (a ui.* adj key).
